scope: The extant Shaul HaMelech museum campus, including the main Paulson building, its immediate attached ranges, the northern relation member and the named Herta and Paul Amir Building.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum describes the 1971 Brutalist main building, four galleries arranged around a spiral atrium and the 2018 restoration.
The museum records the 2011 wing’s triangular site, low silhouette, three levels below grade and 465 folded polished concrete panels.
The architect describes varied levels arranged around the Lightfall and describes the façade’s twisting surfaces. Used written facts only.
The architectural archive differentiates the original 1971 complex, Rich wing and later Amir addition.
